hidden_risks: functional condition of the panel and absence of dead pixels or backlight bleeding
inclusion and condition of the original remote control and power cable
working order of HDMI and USB ports on the rear
response.best_proof: A photo of the back panel ports or a clear view of the TV playing standard video content instead of store demo overlays.
seller_claims_unsupported: exact model year 2025 verification from the photos alone
actual usage history (advertised as used, but appears as shop display stock)
response.failure_mode: Mistaking on-screen promotional graphics or watermarks for stock catalogue photos, or misjudging store display units as purely pre-owned.
